_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Raised single-hung window sash exposing balance hardware in its jamb channel
figures.caption: Confirm whether the issue is the sash balance, weatherstrip, frame, glass, or the entire unit before ordering a replacement. The visible symptom does not always define the right scope.

figures.alt: Window opening with sill flashing membrane folded into a drainage pan
figures.caption: Set the replacement on a prepared sill and integrate flashing in the correct drainage sequence. A window frame cannot compensate for a sill detail that traps water.

figures.alt: Finished single-hung window trim with a sloped exterior sill
figures.caption: Check operation, reveals, exterior sealant, and drainage after installation. The sash should move freely while water is directed outward at the sill and trim.
